sections.changelog: 2.37.17: polishes the live Hadmaia professional-review bridge with stronger visual hierarchy, clearer action chips and safer responsive spacing while preserving indexability and the existing lead path. 2.37.16: server-renders the Hadmaia professional-review bridge before the lawyers directory guidance while keeping the JS asset for form wiring, so the handoff is visible without depending on client-side insertion. 2.37.15: moves the Hadmaia professional-review renderer into a normal plugin asset and keeps only JSON config in the page, so the bridge can run reliably with optimization enabled. 2.37.14: hardens the Hadmaia professional-review bridge by printing the handoff script in the page footer so optimization does not prevent the live bridge from rendering. 2.37.13: bridges Hadmaia simulation product intent into the Justice professional-review lead path without passing case details, and renders a contextual lead bridge when theme Git pull is blocked. 2.37.12: the legal entity network, wave 1 (family law): 47 reference pages seeded as ordinary editable WP pages with clean English slugs, verified 2026 fee amounts and deadlines from official datasets, links to gov.il services and consolidated law texts, an internal mesh to the practice pillars and wave siblings, a plain link to the courtroom simulation, and the standing disclaimer. Seeding is one-time per wave, never overwrites a living slug, and reports at /justice-ops/v1/entity-waves. 2.37.11: removes the utility-page noindex list and the matching sitemap exclusions (owner order 2026-09-07: indexing is the owner's decision only; sitemaps are left untouched either way). The legal-tools archive index forcing stays. 2.37.10: 301 layer for the deleted 2025 winners (164 Hebrew legacy paths measured as pure 404s despite real summer-2025 clicks; each target verified live, off-topic pages honestly left 404; runs only on 404s after the theme layer) plus a one-time refocus of /posta/ away from another outlet's crime-news brand queries (title, description, and the outlet-profile section; via wp_update_post so a revision exists). 2.37.9: aligns main with the live-safe deployment. 2.37.8: makes the homepage AI simulation CTA a real raw HTML URL for crawlers, not only a client-side JavaScript repair. 2.37.7: cleans homepage public status language server-side so crawlers receive the corrected wording. 2.37.6: cleans public homepage status language and keeps the AI links wiring from 2.37.5. 2.37.5: adds safe homepage AI link wiring so visible buttons have real destinations before interaction. 2.37.4: adds a conservative premium visual bridge through the plugin channel while the theme Git pull is repaired. It improves the visible layer and simulation framing without changing URLs, public content, indexability, menus, or database records. 2.37.3: restores the HADMAIA courtroom simulation shortcode on /legal-simulation/ and routes the embedded arena to Hebrew by default. 2.37.2: legacy redirects back on (evidence-driven, pending owner approval). WordPress old-slug 301s and the theme's 2026-05-17 Hebrew-to-English slug map are restored exactly as before 2.37.0 — Search Console showed Google crawling those ranking Hebrew URLs as redirects until 2026-09-02, and 2.37.0/2.37.1 turned them into 404s. Still off: 404 permalink guessing and any canonical redirect on a 404. Shortcode stubs and native auto-update unchanged. 2.37.1: zero-friction r1. The theme's own redirect engine (exact legacy-path map on init, old-slug map on template_redirect) is unhooked by the plugin; two orphaned shortcodes render empty; Justice Ops native auto-update enabled once (owner order: no more manual update clicks). 2.37.0: zero-friction (owner order 2026-09-03). All content redirects off: WordPress old-slug redirects, 404 permalink guessing, and the legacy 301 map are disabled; unknown URLs answer 404 (canonical host/https redirects stay). Plugin now loads only public protection, update control, registration, lead routing, scheduler, sponsored cards, title/claims guards, practice rendering, internal links, calculators, document/rent/divorce generators, malpractice checker, and simulation embed modules. AI/content generators remain unloaded. Status routes: /justice-ops/v1/redirects-off, /justice-ops/v1/cleanup-2026-09. 2.36.0 = cleanup-v1; 2.35.19 = phase-1 recovery release.
